name: Zul'Gurub: Hakkar drains the Avatar of every living High Priest's loa, one after another
contract: Tester feedback round 6 (2026-11-13): Hakkar (14834) devoured only one loa avatar. He summoned one avatar for
each living High Priest and cast Drain Power (2118700, a channel) on all of them at once, so each new channel
interrupted the one before and only the last avatar died; he kept a single Aspect. Drain Power's tooltip
drains the closest Loa Avatar, and live logs show the drains one at a time (user decision 2026-11-13: drain
them in turn from the pull, nearest first, the next when the previous avatar dies). In a fresh Normal
instance all five priests live, so Hakkar must consume all five avatars (666988-666992) and carry all five
Aspects (2118701-2118705). The hero joins phase 1, where Hakkar's ring of avatars appears.
